specification.collation: Use collate_aux: old collate followed by exact saved-Xt override, avoiding recomputation/rounding of the actual trajectory state
specification.gradient: auxiliary masked mean((model(X_saved,t,C)-u_detached)^2) over9*(N-K) free coordinates; coefficient.1 applied by trainer
specification.limitations: Composite state/correspondence intervention; old START replay may become off-policy as training progresses. No claim that the frozen hard S/I/E scores themselves are differentiable.
specification.selection: Per parent: minimum S lower bound, maximum I upper bound, minimum E global lower bound; exact ties use smaller candidate index
specification.target_correctness: Targets are immutable true training GT faces; generated endpoints only establish free face/corner correspondence and supply visited states
specification.teacher_noise_note: Extra teacher control uses the exact frozen inference FP32 Z. The unchanged primary eight-sample training stream retains its original pre-match FP64 Gaussian arithmetic.
specification.teacher_target: nested_ot_map(original_pre_ot_free,saved_FP32_Gaussian_free), then target*2 and inverse mapping; mix Gaussian with independent FP32 epsilon at lambda.25; no second OT
specification.trajectory_target: nested_ot_map(GT_free,final_free), both final model coordinates; to_noise_slots(GT_free); u=(Ymatch-X_saved)/(1-t)
specification.unavailable_score_policy: BLOCKED; never substitute0/1 or remove difficult records
